hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: Each member is reconstructed as the divided difference of the latent function F(t)=f(t) at the specified node sequence; repeated nodes use derivative values according to Hermite divided difference rules.
required_assumptions: x and y are distinct for the divided differences with non-repeated node y
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The three catalog expressions are structured as divided differences of the same univariate function f: G0001 is the first divided difference on distinct nodes {x,y}, G0002 is the first derivative represented by the Hermite divided difference on the repeated node {x,x}, and G0003 is the second-order Hermite divided difference on the node set {x,x,y}. This unifies all three catalog members through one latent function and node multiplicity.
